items.title: SMDownloader
items.en_oneliner: Paste a public post link to preview and save videos, images and audio from 32 platforms, no install or sign-up needed.

items.en_title: Devpack – 450 Free Browser-Based Dev and Everyday Tools, No Sign-Up

items.title: Show HN: I make open-source flight test stand
items.en_title: Flight Test Stand – Check in the Browser Whether Your Aircraft Will Fly
items.en_oneliner: Describe an aircraft or upload its picture, and the stand simulates in the browser whether it will fly and hold together, then hands you a report.

items.title: Show HN: Trenches Terminal – Research stocks, options, and fillings in one app
items.en_title: Trenches Terminal – Research Stocks, Options, and Filings in One App
items.en_oneliner: Market heatmaps, financial statements, options data, and institutional holdings in a single terminal, so stock research stops jumping between sites.

items.title: Show HN: SPF Record Syntax Inspector
items.en_oneliner: Paste an SPF record and check its syntax piece by piece, so you can catch mistakes in your sending-domain setup.

items.title: Show HN: Furrow – How much is your farmland worth?
items.en_title: Furrow: How Much Is Your Farmland Worth?
items.en_oneliner: Search a place, click a field, and see farmland prices drawn from public government sales records — free, no account needed.
